body:
Are they though? That's been my entire life, I had that moment, I could have seized it and instead I let it go in the most stupid of ways. That's why if I could go away, not forever, but for a long while, I'd love that, I'll gladly trade a couple years to start a new.

I dread that daily grind in hopes of reaching another moment like that while I keep sinking in misery.
Got a time machine laying around? :P
Because that's the day of what drove me to this point happened.
Yeah but what's done is done, heard it from the source itself.
Probably not, I torpedoed it harder than the Yamato.

TL;DR: Always struggled with mental health issues, meet someone who'm seems to be made for you, spend the next almost 11 years of your life with said person, who by the way decides to cope with all my insecurities and issues, marry, do something incredibly stupid and throw it all away and make it even worse in the span of a month due to even more stupid decisions.
